page_title: SPA 7-0 COS | Spain v Costa Rica 23/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+7' Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mohammed Mohamed had an easy-decision to make.
90+6' Carlos Soler (Spain) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
90+6' 15:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
90+5' Alejandro Balde (Spain) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

90+2' 7 - 0 Stunning strike! Alvaro Morata (Spain) latches on to a precise through ball from Dani Olmo before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the back of the net from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 7:0.
90+1' Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The attendance for today's match is 40013.
90' 6 - 0 Goal! Carlos Soler (Spain) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 6:0.
90' A pass from Nico Williams (Spain) is intercepted by Keylor Navas and the move breaks down.
88' Spain are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
86' Dani Olmo (Spain) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
85' Brandon Aguilera (Costa Rica) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Today's match ends for Bryan Oviedo who will be replaced by Ronald Matarrita (Costa Rica).
81' Alvaro Morata (Spain) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
78' Kendall Jamaal Waston Manley (Costa Rica) is penalised for a foul. Mohammed Mohamed had a clear view and blows his whistle.
77' 2:7 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.

74' 5 - 0 Sensational! Gavi (Spain) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the bottom of the right post and into the net. The assist goes to Alvaro Morata and the score changes to 5:0.
74' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) heads on.
72' Luis Suarez prepares a substitution. Celso Borges is replaced by Brandon Aguilera (Costa Rica).
70' Dani Olmo (Spain) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Keylor Navas, who pulls off a comfortable save!
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Nico Williams (Spain) coming on for Marco Asensio.
68' Francisco Calvo (Costa Rica) has tested the patience of referee Mohammed Mohamed and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Bryan Oviedo (Costa Rica) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
66' The total number of attempts is 11:0.
64' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Sergio Busquets will be replaced by Koke (Spain).
64' Jordi Alba goes off the pitch and Alejandro Balde (Spain) comes on.
63' What a big chance! Alvaro Morata (Spain) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
62' Alvaro Zamora (Costa Rica) is caught offside!
62' Dani Olmo (Spain) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
61' Luis Suarez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bryan Ruiz (Costa Rica) replacing Jewison Bennette.

58' Dani Olmo (Spain) takes the corner with a short pass.
57' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Dani Olmo (Spain) takes it short.
57' Here is a change. Pedri is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Soler (Spain).
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ferran Torres departs the field of play to be replaced by Alvaro Morata (Spain).
54' 4 - 0 Goal! Ferran Torres (Spain) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 4:0.
54' Ferran Torres (Spain) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
53' Dani Olmo (Spain) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
52' Marco Asensio (Spain) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
52' Good defending. Ferran Torres (Spain) tries to find Dani Olmo inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
49' Dani Olmo (Spain) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
48' Marco Asensio (Spain) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
46' The game is over for Carlos Martinez. Kendall Jamaal Waston Manley (Costa Rica) comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Pedri plays a pass to Marco Asensio (Spain), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the left post.
45+4' Spain keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Jordi Alba (Spain) is flagged for offside.
44' Mohammed Mohamed couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Bryan Oviedo (Costa Rica) and blew his whistle.
43' Marco Asensio (Spain) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
41' The game is interrupted as Bryan Oviedo (Costa Rica) is flagged offside.
41' The current number of shots on goal is 3:0.
38' Carlos Martinez (Costa Rica) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mohammed Mohamed blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Bryan Oviedo (Costa Rica) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
35' Dani Olmo (Spain) is adjudged offside.
33' Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
33' Celso Borges (Costa Rica) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
33' A clumsy foul by Dani Olmo (Spain) and Mohammed Mohamed blows his whistle. A free kick to Costa Rica.
31' 3 - 0 Goal! Ferran Torres (Spain) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Keylor Navas to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
30' Ferran Torres (Spain) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
30' Mohammed Mohamed blows his whistle after Oscar Duarte (Costa Rica) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. PENALTY to Spain! Great chance to score.
27' Gavi (Spain) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
24' Dani Olmo (Spain) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
23' Ferran Torres (Spain) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
21' 2 - 0 What a goal! Jordi Alba plays it to Marco Asensio (Spain), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Keylor Navas into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
21' The percentage of ball possession is – 87:13.
18' Jordi Alba (Spain) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mohammed Mohamed blows for a foul.
17' Francisco Calvo (Costa Rica) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
15' Francisco Calvo (Costa Rica) trips an opposition player and Mohammed Mohamed signals a foul.
11' 1 - 0 GOAL! Dani Olmo (Spain) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Keylor Navas, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
9' That was close by Marco Asensio (Spain)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
8' A spell of possession for Spain in an attempt to control the game.
5' Dani Olmo (Spain) gets on the end of a cross from Pedri, but his shot goes a whisker wide of the left post.
4' Aymeric Laporte (Spain) brings his opponent down. Mohammed Mohamed has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Dani Olmo (Spain) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
2' Ferran Torres (Spain) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Spain force a corner. They send men into the box.
